selection_rule: Union of top three J-T coarse far20 increasing sources and top three J-T dense E Cover@2 decreasing sources; five fixed defects each; focus on worst case per selected source/criterion plus new severe case
limitations: Existing arrays do not identify the first internal learned feature or token where error occurs
S to Q displacement is descriptive, not a GT-aligned anchor error; no Qraw exists in this OASG output
Source selection is post-hoc and cannot alter original gate or remove cases
Observed tradeoffs cannot establish the causal loss gradient mechanism
